behavior_change_from_previous: a patch release on 0.31.0 for the crun.after hook's bound: at crun.after-timeout, or when the run is interrupted, the hook's process group is sent SIGTERM, SIGKILL to what is left of it five seconds later, and crun returns once the group is gone; the parity suite's hook check looks for the hook's own process group; every counter is 0.31.0's (configuration schema 6, registry 30, execution plan 13, daemon IPC 12, command record 3, job manifest and summary 4, plan report 2, credential package 2, scoreboard 3, audit 1); the first submission after the upgrade drains a 0.31.0 daemon; see CHANGELOG.md

build.dependencies: vendored (go.mod, go.sum, vendor/); built with no network

daemon_upgrade_recovery.job_submission_schema: exact-current-only (the client's IPC schema and build)
daemon_upgrade_recovery.automatic_replacement: a client launching its own daemon (daemon.launch client) drains a daemon of another build at its own schema: idle, it exits and the client starts its own in the same invocation; busy, it finishes its jobs and exits after the last, each submission meanwhile refused daemon_draining (exit 112); a service account's daemon (daemon.launch systemd) is never drained by a client, and its unit is restarted
daemon_upgrade_recovery.incompatible_run_error: daemon_incompatible (a daemon of a newer IPC schema); daemon_draining (a drained daemon finishing its jobs)
daemon_upgrade_recovery.actual_lifecycle_replay: not run: the newest release whose daemon IPC schema (11) differs from this client's (12) is v0.29.0, whose daemon predates the drain that exits and listens on daemon.sock, which this client never reaches; the compatibility example ran before the number was committed: beside the released v0.31.0 daemon, at this client's schema and of another build, the client's daemon status stacked the two builds (compatible: false), its run's exercise drained the idle daemon and started its own (exit 0, no device contacted), and with the older daemon holding a job on the fake device the client's run was refused daemon_draining (exit 112), the daemon exiting after the job (evidence/ipc-schema-compat.log)
